mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversation ( user_id, ai_model, session_id, session_context, status, start_time, end_time, last_interaction_time, total_messages, is_deleted, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{aiModel}, #{sessionId}, #{sessionContext}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{lastInteractionTime}, #{totalMessages}, #{isDeleted}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_conversation WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation SET user_id = #{userId}, ai_model = #{aiModel}, session_id = #{sessionId}, session_context = #{sessionContext}, status = #{status}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, last_interaction_time = #{lastInteractionTime}, total_messages = #{totalMessages}, is_deleted = #{isDeleted}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS conversationId, c.ai_model AS aiModel, c.session_id AS sessionId, c.status, c.last_interaction_time AS lastInteractionTime, c.total_messages AS totalMessages, (SELECT m.content FROM ai_message m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id ORDER BY m.send_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessage FROM ai_conversation c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.last_interaction_time DESC
